title: [v6.1] CI: use go v1.26 for both `release.yml` and `ci.yml` (don't use `go.mod` version)
body:
Cherry-pick of #29903
```
Users have reported issues with Podman built with the stable Go version (the version used in the release workflow): #29891.

The problem hasn't been reproduced in PR checks because they use a different Go version (from `go.mod`).

This commit updates `ci.yaml` to match `release-build-artifacts.yml`.

It also sets the Go version to v1.26 to fix #29891.

(cherry picked from commit d06e6c3452e69403ddafb79f8d3ba4fa57898a67)
```
